title_en: Regulations on Counteracting Improper Extraterritorial Jurisdiction of Foreign Countries of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
Article 5 The State shall establish and improve a working mechanism concerning responses to foreign improper extraterritorial jurisdiction (hereinafter referred to as the working mechanism), and shall coordinate the work of responding to foreign improper extraterritorial jurisdiction.
Relevant departments of the State Council shall undertake the specific work of responding to foreign improper extraterritorial jurisdiction in accordance with their respective functions and duties. Relevant departments of the State Council and other relevant authorities shall strengthen the coordination and information sharing in the identification of and response to foreign improper extraterritorial jurisdiction measures.

Article 7 The Chinese Government may assess the acts of imposing improper extraterritorial jurisdiction measures by relevant countries, determine the risk level, and take countermeasures and restrictive measures in areas such as diplomacy and foreign affairs, exit and entry, trade, investment, international cooperation, and foreign assistance according to law.

Article 9 Organizations and individuals subject to countermeasures and restrictive measures may apply to the relevant department of the State Council that made the decision to impose the countermeasures and restrictive measures to suspend, modify, or cancel the relevant countermeasures and restrictive measures. When applying, they shall provide facts and reasons regarding their corrective actions, measures taken to eliminate the consequences of their actions, and other matters.
The relevant department of the State Council that made the decision to impose the countermeasures and restrictive measures may, based on actual circumstances, organize an assessment of the implementation and effects of the countermeasures and restrictive measures.
The relevant department of the State Council that made the decision to impose the countermeasures and restrictive measures may, based on the assessment results or the review of relevant applications, in accordance with the decision-making procedures of the working mechanism, make a decision to suspend, modify, or cancel the relevant countermeasures and restrictive measures, and issue a public announcement.

Article 10 Where the relevant countermeasures and restrictive measures need to be implemented by other departments of the State Council, the relevant department of the State Council that made the decision to impose, suspend, modify, or cancel the countermeasures and restrictive measures shall, in accordance with the procedures of the working mechanism, notify the department of the State Council responsible for implementation of the decision on the relevant countermeasures and restrictive measures.
The relevant department of the State Council that receives the decision on the relevant countermeasures and restrictive measures shall implement it in accordance with its functions and duties.

Article 11 Where relevant organizations or individuals, under special circumstances, truly need to engage in prohibited or restricted relevant activities with organizations or individuals subject to countermeasures and restrictive measures, they shall apply to the relevant department of the State Council that made the decision to impose the countermeasures and restrictive measures and provide the corresponding facts and reasons. After approval in accordance with the decision-making procedures of the working mechanism, they may engage in relevant activities with the organizations or individuals subject to countermeasures and restrictive measures.

Article 12 Relevant departments of the State Council may take measures such as on-site inspection, access to and copying of relevant materials against organizations and individuals suspected of executing or assisting in the execution of foreign improper extraterritorial jurisdiction measures. The relevant organizations and individuals shall provide assistance and cooperation, and shall not refuse or obstruct.

Article 13 Relevant departments of the State Council may conduct interviews and order corrections for organizations and individuals that execute or assist in the execution of foreign improper extraterritorial jurisdiction measures.
The rule of law department of the State Council may, in accordance with the decision-making procedures of the working mechanism, make a decision prohibiting the execution of foreign improper extraterritorial jurisdiction measures (hereinafter referred to as the prohibition order) against organizations and individuals that execute or assist in the execution of foreign improper extraterritorial jurisdiction measures. The relevant organizations and individuals shall comply with the prohibition order.

Article 14 If any organization or individual executes or assists in the execution of foreign improper extraterritorial jurisdiction measures and infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of Chinese citizens or organizations, the Chinese citizens or organizations may institute a lawsuit in the People's Court according to law, requesting cessation of the infringement and compensation for losses.

Article 15 The relevant departments of the people's governments at or above the provincial level shall, in accordance with their respective functions and duties, provide guidance and services for Chinese citizens and organizations to respond to improper extraterritorial jurisdiction of foreign countries.

Article 16 Trade associations and chambers of commerce shall, in accordance with laws, regulations, and their articles of association, play a role in industry self-discipline and coordination, guide members to operate in compliance with laws and regulations, timely reflect industry demands, and provide members with services related to market expansion, rights and interests protection, dispute resolution, and other aspects in connection with responding to improper extraterritorial jurisdiction of foreign countries.

Article 17 Where any person refuses to implement or circumvents the implementation of the countermeasures and restrictive measures provided for in these Regulations, or violates the prohibition order, the relevant departments of the State Council may order rectification, prohibit or restrict such person from engaging in government procurement, tenders and bids, and the import or export of relevant goods, technologies, or international service trade, and other activities; prohibit or restrict such person from receiving from or providing to overseas entities any data or personal information; prohibit or restrict such person from leaving or entering the country, or from staying or residing within the territory of China; and impose fines, among other measures.
Article 18 Whoever violates the provisions of these Regulations, if the act constitutes a crime, shall be investigated for criminal liability according to law.

Article 19 Matters relating to anti-corruption, anti-monopoly, anti-unfair competition, export control, data security, judicial assistance, and other related work that involve responding to improper extraterritorial jurisdiction of foreign countries shall, if otherwise provided by laws or regulations, be governed by those provisions.
Matters relating to work in responding to a foreign country that, in violation of international law and the basic norms of international relations, improperly prohibits or restricts Chinese citizens and organizations from conducting normal economic and trade and related activities with third countries (regions) and their citizens and organizations shall, if otherwise provided by the state, be governed by those provisions.
Article 20 These Regulations shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
